title: Xiaohongshu Marketing Agency | Expert RedNote Marketing | Charlesworth

facts.fact: Charlesworth states it has over 25 years of expertise in driving China growth for brands worldwide (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: Charlesworth boasts over 25 years of expertise in driving China growth for brands worldwide.

facts.fact: Charlesworth's Essential package for Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) lists four components: account setup with basic branding, regular posting, community management, and essential-metrics reporting.
facts.quote: Kick-start your Little Red Book presence with our Essential package, including:

facts.fact: Charlesworth's Amplify package adds content strategy and creation, Little Red Book Ads, influencer partnerships, and advanced reporting on top of the Essential package.
facts.quote: Enhance all the benefits of the Essential package, with our amplified features, including:

facts.fact: Charlesworth's Premium package lists five premium features on top of the Amplify package, including KOL marketing, comment section management, and influencer campaign management.
facts.quote: Make a real difference with all the benefits of our Amplify package plus premium features, including:

facts.fact: The page describes Xiaohongshu, also known as Little Red Book or RedNote, as often described as China's equivalent to Instagram while also serving as a search engine, e-commerce platform, and lifestyle-sharing app.
facts.quote: Xiaohongshu also known as Little Red Book or RedNote is often described as China’s equivalent to Instagram, but it offers far more.
